body_text:
Dear students,

I am Mei Qi, the Sec 3 girls captain.The badminton team is proud to invite
you to join us for training on 16 Jan Wednesday, 4.30 - 6.30 or 18 Jan
Friday, 2.30 - 4.30. You can choose either one of this dates to join us and
you only need to attend one of them Through this, you will be able to
experience what an ordinary training session will be like. You are advised
to attend in your S&W attire and also bring along a racket if you have it
at home. However, it is fine if you don't have one as rackets and
shuttlecocks will be provided.
We look forward to seeing you on Wednesday or Friday :) If there are any
questions, you are free to email me (user_1ee853be@redacted.test).

Regards,
*Chong Mei Qi 张美琪*,
Student of S3-05
*School of Science and Technology, **Singapore*

1 Technology Drive, Singapore 138572
T: (65) [phone_bd2a6d4a] | F: (65) [phone_55758dd3]
